weakness: One shared SCADA operator login for 4 field staff; no account procedure, approvals, reviews, or termination alignment
source: P07 (AC-02 objectives); P01 R-001 R-010; P03 G-002
remediation_plan: Named SCADA accounts for each user and a view-only alarm display account; onboarding and termination checklist covering SCADA, AMI, suite, email, vault, keys; monthly account review
milestones: 2026-07-24 shared password changed; 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-10-31 named accounts live and shared login disabled; 2026-11-30 first monthly review
resources_required: SCADA vendor named-account licensing (about $900 a year with MFA); staff time

weakness: No MFA on SCADA, the AMI head-end, or the vault administrator login
remediation_plan: Enable the SCADA vendor MFA feature for all accounts; MSP enables MFA on the vault login; AMI vendor enables MFA or provides a dated plan
milestones: 2026-10-31 SCADA and vault MFA; 2026-11-30 AMI MFA
resources_required: Included in SCADA licensing above; MSP labor

weakness: Line recloser modems on public-IP data plans; LR-4 management page reachable from the internet with a default password
source: P07 test 2026-08-11 (new finding); P01 R-002; P04 finding 2
remediation_plan: Move all 6 modems to the carrier private network used by the substation gateway; confirm with an external scan; keep management ports closed
milestones: 2026-08-12 passwords changed and ports closed by carrier setting; 2026-11-30 private network order; 2026-12-31 all 6 moved and scan clean
resources_required: About $1,200 one-time and part of $1,400 a year (carrier plans)

weakness: SCADA vendor support holds standing administrator access; HMI accepts sign-ins from any address; no remote access rules
source: P07 (AC-17 objectives); P01 R-008; P04 finding 3
remediation_plan: Vendor access enabled on request for a set window and logged (POL-02 B.6); limit HMI sign-in to cooperative devices; security terms in the SCADA contract
milestones: 2026-10-31 on-request access and device limits; 2026-12-31 contract amendment

weakness: No OT or endpoint inventory; firmware versions unknown
source: P07 (CM-08 objectives); P03 G-002 G-023; P01 R-002
remediation_plan: One-sheet inventory of every RTU, recloser and regulator control, gateway, modem, collector, and endpoint with model, firmware, location, and owner; updated after each change and at each risk register update
resources_required: Line Superintendent and Meter and Service Technician time (about 2 days)

weakness: Default passwords on recloser controls; shared password passed by text; no password procedures
remediation_plan: Unique password per device stored in a password manager (POL-02 B.7); procedure for issuing and changing passwords; change device passwords when people leave
milestones: 2026-08-12 modem passwords changed; 2026-09-30 recloser and regulator control passwords changed; 2026-10-31 password manager in use
resources_required: Password manager (about $60 a year); Line Superintendent time

weakness: Device settings and point database copied by hand (last February 2026); vault copies not immutable; ERP and VRA not backed up
remediation_plan: Settings and point database copied after every change and monthly; object lock with 90-day retention; scanned ERP and VRA in the vault; quarterly restore test to the spare recloser control
milestones: 2026-09-30 settings copied; 2026-10-31 object lock; 2026-11-30 first restore test
resources_required: About $600 a year; spare recloser control about $2,800 one-time

weakness: Operations workstation and truck tablets unmanaged; no firmware tracking or updates for field devices
remediation_plan: Enroll the operations workstation and tablets in MSP management; subscribe to vendor advisories for every OT model in the inventory; firmware review with the recloser vendor and a planned update window
milestones: 2026-10-31 devices enrolled; 2026-11-30 advisory subscriptions; 2026-12-31 firmware review done
resources_required: MSP management about $1,700 a year (with EDR); vendor time

weakness: Any of 4 AMI users can disconnect or curtail any number of meters without a second approval
remediation_plan: Remove disconnect rights from users who do not need them; two-person rule above 5 meters; medical-needs check before disconnect (POL-02 B.2)
milestones: 2026-09-30 rights reduced; 2026-11-30 two-person rule enabled by the AMI vendor

weakness: ERP lacks a Business Continuity Section; contacts out of date; not signed by the current General Manager; one copy
remediation_plan: Rebuild contacts; write the Business Continuity Section from the BIA; attach the P08 runbook as the cyber annex; copies in trucks and homes; General Manager signature and Board approval
milestones: 2026-10-31 contacts and copies; 2027-01-31 updated ERP approved by the Board
resources_required: General Manager and Line Superintendent time

weakness: No incident reporting rule; DOE-417 duty unknown; no filing arrangement with the G&T or BA
source: P07 interviews; P03 G-038 G-039; P01 R-014 R-015
remediation_plan: POL-03 4.2 reporting rule on a card in every truck and office; written DOE-417 filing arrangement; DOE-417 account set up; runbook steps (P08)
milestones: 2026-09-30 cards issued; 2026-10-31 filing arrangement and account

weakness: No security training, awareness, or phishing exercises; BEC lessons not shared
remediation_plan: Yearly training with an OT module for field staff; quarterly phishing simulations; callback rule briefing (POL-02 C.7)
milestones: 2026-10-15 callback rule briefing; 2026-10-31 first training; 2026-12-31 first simulation

weakness: Substation and cabinet keys untracked; locks not changed after a departure; no entry log
source: P07 (PE-03 objectives); P03 G-007; P01 R-020
remediation_plan: Restricted-key padlocks and cabinet locks with a key log; entry noted on the weekly check sheet; cabinet door switch alarmed to SCADA
